newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ NBR's Internet service goes on line on Friday.
newsitem.headline: NZ NBR's Internet service goes on line on Friday.

text.p: The National Business Review's Business Centre Online Service will go live on the Internet on Friday, the centre's manager Graeme Colman said on Wednesday.

Colman told a news conference the service would allow Internet users to buy parcels of shares, assess property investments, carry out credit record checks, place and amend classified ads and apply for jobs.
The service brings together the major wire services, business databases, commercial information services and interactive facilities.

A number of news and information services will be available free to casual users. Additional services will be available free to registered users, while subscribers will have further access to the centre's enhanced database and information services.
The centre comprises more than 1,500 pages and NBR publisher Liberty Press expects it to become the largest commercial Internet site in New Zealand.
